name: Protecting the Herd
summary: At Amberstill Ranch, Rudra Amberstill fears Vagash will take more prized mountain rams. He asks passing fighters to protect the herd and bring proof of the predator’s death.

sections.title: A Threat to the Ranch
sections.body: Vagash has taken two prized mountain rams from Amberstill Ranch. The ranch supplies the Bronzebeard dwarves with riding and working beasts, and the herd supports Dun Morogh’s rustic economy. Vagash hunts local livestock in the crags above the ranch.

sections.title: Strained Defenses
sections.body: Ironforge’s forces are spread thin across the realm, supporting the Alliance on distant frontiers. With no military patrol on the ridgelines, Rudra Amberstill asks independent fighters to hunt Vagash. He wants one of the beast’s deadly fangs as proof.

faq.answer: Vagash is a dangerous predator that stalks the snowy ridges above Amberstill Ranch. His strength and vicious appetite threaten the ranch’s prized rams and travelers in eastern Dun Morogh.
Vagash makes his den in a snow-covered cave high in the crags above Amberstill Ranch. Climb the snowy hill beyond the pine trees behind the homestead to reach its mouth.

faq.q: Why are the Ironforge guards not handling this?
faq.answer: Ironforge’s forces are spread thin across distant garrisons and Alliance campaigns. Amberstill Ranch has no nearby military help, so its breeders must defend the homestead or seek capable fighters.

faq.q: Who is Veron mentioned by Rudra?
faq.answer: Veron Amberstill breeds, trains, and tends the Bronzebeards’ riding rams at the ranch. Rudra says Veron will be relieved when the predator stalking their prized animals is gone.

faq.q: Why is proof of the kill required?
faq.answer: Rudra wants Vagash’s fang as proof that the monster terrorizing the herd is dead, not some common prowler from the mountain slopes.

faq.q: What importance do the rams have to Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Mountain rams are hardy and sure-footed across Khaz Modan’s freezing, rocky ground. They provide the dwarves with draft power, wool, and cavalry mounts.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help defend the mountain rams that carry your kin into battle across Khaz Modan.
As a hunter, tracking Vagash to his mountain den tests your skill in Dun Morogh’s snowdrifts.
As an Alliance fighter, you can aid rural homesteads while High Seat regiments support Alliance commitments across the Eastern Kingdoms.
